name: vibecraft
description: 3D status monitor for the Claude Code sessions running in your terminals
author: nearcyan

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:rust
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:rust && node --test 'tests/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.bench: cargo build --release --examples --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && npm run build:rust && node bench/hook.bench.ts && node bench/server.bench.ts
